details: sanka-baileyss is a modified fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web API library that silently enrols any account using it into two fixed WhatsApp channels and injects the operator's channel into the account's outgoing messages. lib/Socket/newsletter.js, evaluated as soon as the socket module is loaded, schedules a 90-second timer that sends a newsletter FOLLOW query (w:mex query channel, QueryIds.FOLLOW) for 120363404901093286@newsletter and then a nested 5-second timer that sends the same FOLLOW for 120363419564423145@newsletter; both calls are wrapped in empty try/catch blocks so the account owner sees nothing. The identifiers are deliberately assembled at runtime from decimal char-code arrays rather than written as literals: lib/Utils/messages.js decodes 120363404901093286, @newsletter and SANKANIME and installs them as defaultAnnotation.newsletter (contentType UPDATE) on media the account uploads, so the operator's channel is attached to the user's media; lib/Utils/generics.js builds a hardcoded "SANKA-" message-ID prefix; lib/Socket/socket.js builds a hardcoded fallback pairing code from a char-code array; and lib/Socket/sanka.js and lib/Socket/newsletter.js set forwardedNewsletterMessageInfo (newsletterJid 120363404901093286@newsletter, newsletterName SANKANIME) on status and broadcast messages. The only network destination in the package is the WhatsApp endpoint wss://web[.]whatsapp[.]com/ws/chat and the preinstall hook is a Node.js version check. Behaviour: unauthorised channel subscription and outgoing-message metadata modification, hidden behind char-code obfuscation and delayed timers.
